notes.title: WH4 - Voyage
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We have a DLC release today - Voyage. This is a small addition, but includes 19 new scenes + one.  The plot revolves around the missing maids, and moves to the under the moon world. There are three options to finish the game
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3534180/Witch_4_Hotel_Voyage/?curator_clanid=34719194

 1- Use the absolute weapon at the very end, by selecting it in the dialog with the wagon driver. You can get it while playing as Melissa. Do not agree to ride with the conductor in his wagon, go ahead 1. Just take the ticket in the puddle (no need to say hello) 2. Orc when you pass him, go back and he's gone, take the ticket. 3) Tell the Succubus that the Orc is gone (when you take the ticket. Next, go back to the carriage driver, next to him take the chest, and give him the ticket. He takes you to his fortress and there you use the weapon.


 2 - Do not use absolute weapons, even if you have them.


 3. The scene of Chelsea and her double, you need to have sex with all the visitors of the restaurant (it is not difficult at all) and at the end do not use weapons after the scene with Melissa and Chelsea - you will have a second scene with Chelsea's double
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974574/0599140ffc179dd2155933c2d30dafb0bc22f4e4.jpg


 4. Melissa is taken by the Carriage Driver, playing as Melissa fuck all the ghosts of the under the moon world and agree to go with the Carriage Driver in his compartment. (Chelsea is not supposed to provide sexual favors in the restaurant).


 5. This add-on is made so that you still come to the end of the journey. So some scenes you'll still miss by choosing between options, and I'll point out how to get them.

Hotel.

 Plumber: if you don't pay with money from the cash register, you will have a sex scene. But then there won't be a Seduction scene with Melissa. 


 Temptation - pay the last of the money to the plumber, then Melissa will go to room service.

Under the moon:

 Knight - If you don't want to entertain the knight, there won't be a scene, but he will send you down a long road.


 Scorpion - Examine the torch but don't light it, a scorpion will come running after 2 seconds.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974574/bf4905dc4f0f44cc20e720307938480a911cdf8f.jpg
 The bald trickster. - do as he wants, if you choose to leave he won't talk to you and you can go on.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974574/6ef03bbf8f621a74ce5d9edea0a6fcfc994e4e45.jpg

Dungeon.

 Slug
If you don't want to serve customers, you can just leave the restaurant, you can leave right after the dialog with Chelsea's doppelganger. When you leave you will be in the dungeon - you need to find a way out, but if you stand and wait for all the torches on the walls to go out, you will get a scene with a 
slug. 


 Knight
Knight in the basement - You can just leave, for this you should not be afraid to climb into the coffin, but you can choose to provide services for the knight and get the scene.

P.S
Absolute weapon is a gift from Dripley and we will be looking for it in the second part of CODE PANDORA. ːVR_helmetːːtainted_Loveː
For those who already have the previously released DLC I recommend you to take the new DLC in the set
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/51249/Witch_4_Collection/
